newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-West spot power rises in cold weather.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-West spot power rises in cold weather.

text.p: U.S. Midwestern spot wholesale electricity prices were mostly higher Wednesday with cold weather that kept daytime high temperatures below freezing in parts of Minnesota, brokers and marketers said.
Strong natural gas prices and some generation unit outages also were putting some upward pressure on prices, the sources said.
Peak, non-firm power for Thursday delivery in the Mid-Continent Area Power Pool (MAPP) region was quoted higher at $20.00-24.00 from $18.00-21.00 in Tuesday discussion.
Off-peak non-firm MAPP power was said to have held steady at $10.00-11.50 per megawatt hour (MWh).
Some MAPP November and December peak power was being talked at $18.00-20.00 per MWh.
In the Mid-American Interpool Network (MAIN), non-firm peak power was talked at $20.00-24.00 from Tuesday discussion at $18.50-20.75, the brokers and marketers said.
Off-peak next day MAIN power was pegged steady at $12.00-14.00 per MWh.
Peak non-firm power prices in the Southwest Power Pool (SPP) were talked at $20.00-24.00 in the north, and at $25.00-28.00 in the southern portion of the region.
SPP next-day peak power was talked near $27.00 in the south on Tuesday.
Off-peak prices throughout SPP were reported to be steady to higher at $12.00-16.00 from a range of $12.00-14.00 on Tuesday, the sources said.
Peak November SPP power was said to be talked at $20.50-21.50 with few deals being done, while December SPP was talked at $21.50-22.00, the sources said.
In the East Central Area Coordination Agreement (ECAR), peak, non-firm electricity prices for Thursday delivery were assessed lower at $18.00-19.00 from $19.00-21.50 on Tuesday, the sources said.
Off-peak next-day ECAR power was talked steady in the $12.50-14.00 area, the sources said.
November ECAR was being talked higher at $17.50-18.00 from $17.00-17.40 on Tuesday, while December was pegged higher at $19.20-19.50 from $18.70-19.10 on Tuesday.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
